cues.en: Let's dive into regularization techniques in the world of neural networks.
cues.zh: 深入談談神經網路的正規化技術。

cues.en: What is regularization anyway.
cues.zh: 正規化到底是什麼？

cues.en: Well basically regularization is any technique that is intended to prevent overfitting. What is overfitting?
cues.zh: 基本上，正規化是任何用來防止過度擬合的技術。那過度擬合是什麼？

cues.en: Well if you have a model that's good at making predictions on the data it was trained on, but it doesn't do so well on new data that it hasn't seen before.
cues.zh: 如果模型對訓練過的資料預測很好，但對從沒看過的新資料，表現不好，

cues.en: Then we say that that model is overfitted.
cues.zh: 就說這個模型過度擬合。

cues.en: That means that it's learned patterns in your training data that don't really exist in the general sense in the real world.
cues.zh: 表示它學到訓練資料中的模式，但那些模式在真實世界的一般情況，其實不存在。

cues.en: So if you see a high accuracy on your training data set but a lower accuracy on your test set or your evaluation data set.
cues.zh: 因此，訓練集準確率很高，測試集或評估資料集卻較低，

cues.en: That's nature's way of telling you that you might be overfitting.
cues.zh: 就是在告訴你，可能過度擬合。

cues.en: Let's take a step back here.
cues.zh: 退一步。

cues.en: This is the first time I've used the word evaluation data set.
cues.zh: 這是我第一次用「評估資料集」這個詞。

cues.en: Again if you're new to this world, in the world of Deep Learning, typically we talk about three different data sets.
cues.zh: 如果是新手，深度學習領域，通常會談三種不同資料集。

cues.en: So we have the training data set.
cues.zh: 有訓練資料集。

cues.en: This is the actual training data fed into your neural network from the bottom up.
cues.zh: 也就是從底部送進神經網路的實際訓練資料。

cues.en: And that's what we actually train the network on.
cues.zh: 真正用它訓練網路。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: And then as we're training each epoch we can evaluate the results of that network against an evaluation dataset.
cues.zh: 每個訓練週期中，也能用評估資料集，評估網路結果。

cues.en: So basically that's the set of the training set that's set aside to evaluate the results and the accuracy of your model as it's being trained.
cues.zh: 基本上，是從訓練資料留出的部分，用來在模型訓練時，評估結果與準確率。

cues.en: And then we can also have a testing dataset that lives outside of all of that.
cues.zh: 另外，還能有一份完全獨立的測試資料集。

cues.en: So once we have a fully trained model we can then use our testing data set to evaluate the complete finished model if you will.
cues.zh: 模型完整訓練後，用測試資料集，評估最後完成的模型。

cues.en: So again if you're seeing your training accuracy being a lot more than the accuracy measured against your evaluation data or your testing data at the end that probably means you're overfitting to the
cues.zh: 再次強調，如果訓練準確率，遠高於評估資料或最後測試資料測得的準確率，可能表示對

cues.en: training data.
cues.zh: 訓練資料過度擬合。

cues.en: This graph on the right here makes a little bit more easy to understand.
cues.zh: 右邊的圖，讓它更容易理解。

cues.en: So imagine I'm trying to build a model that just separates out things that are blue from things that are red here.
cues.zh: 想像建立模型，分開這裡藍色與紅色的東西。

cues.en: So if you eyeball this data your brain can pretty much figure out that this probably this curve that kind of separates where the bluish stuff is and where the redish stuff is right.
cues.zh: 目測資料，人腦大概能看出，可能有一條這樣的曲線，分隔偏藍與偏紅的區域，對吧？

cues.en: But in the real world data is messy there's a little bit of noise there too.
cues.zh: 但真實資料很亂，也有一些雜訊。

cues.en: So if a model were overfitting it might actually learn that green curve there that's actually sneaking in and out of all the data to try to like fit that training data.
cues.zh: 如果過度擬合，模型可能學到綠色曲線，在資料間穿來穿去，試圖

cues.en: Exactly.
cues.zh: 完全符合訓練資料。

cues.en: But you know that's just noise right.
cues.zh: 但那只是雜訊，對吧？

cues.en: I mean just looking at it your brain knows that that's not correct but your neural network doesn't really have that intuition built into it.
cues.zh: 人腦光看，就知道不對，但神經網路沒有內建這種直覺。

cues.en: So we need regularization techniques to sort of prevent that from happening. To prevent a neural network or any machine learning model from curving an undulating and sort of making these higher frequency pass
cues.zh: 因此，需要正規化技術，避免神經網路或任何機器學習模型，彎來彎去，產生這種高頻路徑，

cues.en: out of the way to overfit its data to its model.
cues.zh: 繞路來對資料過度擬合。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: That's what over fitting it's it's a good way to generalize it.
cues.zh: 這就是過度擬合，很適合用來概括理解。

cues.en: The so-called correct answer, the correct model would be that black line but an overfitted model would be more like the Green Line.
cues.zh: 所謂正確答案、正確模型，是黑線；過度擬合的模型，則像綠線。

cues.en: And this is actually something that really happens in neural networks.
cues.zh: 神經網路確實會發生這種事。

cues.en: If you have a really deep neural network with lots of weights and connections and neurons that are built into it it can totally pick up on complex patterns like that.
cues.zh: 如果網路很深，有很多權重、連線與神經元，完全能學到這種複雜模式。

cues.en: So you do have to be careful with it.
cues.zh: 所以，必須小心。

cues.en: So that's where the world of regularization techniques come in.
cues.zh: 這就是正規化技術的用途。

cues.en: Let's go into some. So a very simple thing might be you might just have too complex of a model.
cues.zh: 介紹幾種。一個簡單可能，是模型太複雜。

cues.en: Maybe you have too many layers or too many neurons so you could have a deep neural network that's too deep or maybe too wide.
cues.zh: 也許層數太多、神經元太多，網路太深，或太寬。

cues.en: Or maybe both.
cues.zh: 也可能兩者都是。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So by actually simplifying your model down that restricts its ability to learn those more complicated patterns that might be over fitting.
cues.zh: 簡化模型，就限制它學習可能造成過度擬合的複雜模式的能力。

cues.en: So a very simple model that's just a simple curve like that that could probably be achieved through a regression.
cues.zh: 很簡單的模型，只有一條簡單曲線，可能用迴歸就能做到。

cues.en: Maybe you're better off with a simpler model and the simplest regularization technique is simply to use fewer neurons or use fewer layers.
cues.zh: 也許簡單模型更好，而最簡單的正規化技術，就是減少神經元或層數。

cues.en: That is a totally valid thing to do.
cues.zh: 這完全合理。

cues.en: Sometimes you do experiment with that.
cues.zh: 有時確實要做這類實驗。

cues.en: So if you find that your model is over fitting probably the simplest thing is just to use a simpler model.
cues.zh: 因此，發現過度擬合時，最簡單的方法，可能就是用更簡單模型。

cues.en: Try fewer layers, try fewer neurons in each layer and see what kind of an effect that has.
cues.zh: 試更少層、每層更少神經元，看看有什麼影響。

cues.en: If you can still have the same accuracy in your test dataset but not overfit to your training dataset then why use more neurons and you need. Another technique is called dropout and this is kind of an interesting
cues.zh: 如果測試集準確率相同，卻不會對訓練集過度擬合，何必用超過需要的神經元？另一種技術叫 Dropout，非常有趣，

cues.en: one.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: So the idea with a dropout layer is that it actually removes some of the neurons in your network at each epoch as its training and this has the effect of basically forcing your model to learn and spread out
cues.zh: Dropout 層的概念，是每個訓練週期移除部分神經元，強迫模型學習，將學習分散到

cues.en: its learning amongst the different neurons and layers within your network.
cues.zh: 不同神經元與各層。

cues.en: So by dropping out specific neurons, that are chosen at random at each training step, we're basically forcing the learning to spread itself out more.
cues.zh: 每步隨機移除特定神經元，基本上就是強迫學習更分散。

cues.en: And this has the effect of preventing any individual neuron from over fitting to a specific data point.
cues.zh: 效果是，防止任何個別神經元，對特定資料點過度擬合。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So it's a little bit counterintuitive that actually removing neurons from your own network can make it actually train better but that's what happens that prevents overfitting.
cues.zh: 移除網路神經元，反而能訓練得更好，雖然反直覺，但確實如此，能防止過度擬合。

cues.en: So that's what dropout is all about.
cues.zh: 這就是 Dropout。

cues.en: Again a very effective regularization technique.
cues.zh: 同樣，是非常有效的正規化技術。

cues.en: We see this a lot in say CNN for example it's pretty standard to have a pretty aggressive dropout layer like maybe even 50 percent being held out for each training pass.
cues.zh: 例如 CNN 很常看到，相當強的 Dropout 層很標準，每輪甚至排除 50%。

cues.en: So that's all dropout is is history moving some neurons at random at each training step to force your model to spread it's learning out a little bit better.
cues.zh: Dropout 就是每個訓練步驟，隨機移除部分神經元，強迫模型更好地分散學習。

cues.en: And that has a regualization effect that prevents over fitting.
cues.zh: 這產生正規化效果，防止過度擬合。

cues.en: Another very simple solution is called early stopping.
cues.zh: 另一個非常簡單的方法，是提早停止。

cues.en: So let's take a look at this printout as we're actually training a real neural network so you can see that if you look at the accuracy on the validation set that's the right hand column there.
cues.zh: 看看真正訓練神經網路時的輸出，右邊那欄是驗證集準確率。

cues.en: We're going from 95 percent to 97 percent and things are getting better and then all of a sudden we get up to like around 98 percent and things start to get weird it starts to oscillate right.
cues.zh: 從 95% 到 97%，越來越好，突然到了大約 98%，開始變奇怪，出現波動，對吧？

cues.en: So we can say just by looking at this that after around epoch five we're not doing any any more benefit by training further. In fact, we might be doing more harm than good because at this point we're probably
cues.zh: 光看這裡，就能說大約第五個訓練週期後，繼續訓練沒有更多好處，甚至可能弊大於利，因為此時大概

cues.en: starting to over fit.
cues.zh: 開始過度擬合。

cues.en: And indeed if you look at the training set accuracy that's that first column of accuracy the second column of numbers that see in this display.
cues.zh: 確實，看訓練集準確率，也就是第一個準確率欄、畫面中的第二欄數字，

cues.en: The accuracy and the training set continues to increase as we train more and more epochs.
cues.zh: 隨著訓練週期增加，訓練集準確率持續提升。

cues.en: But the accuracy on the validation set pretty much stopped getting better at around epoch five.
cues.zh: 但驗證集準確率，大約第五個週期，就不再改善。

cues.en: So this is pretty clearly starting to overfit beyond the fifth epoch.
cues.zh: 因此，第五個週期後，很明顯開始過度擬合。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: All early stopping is, is a way of automatically detecting that and it's an algorithm that will just say OK the validation accuracy has leveled out my training accuracy is still increasing.
cues.zh: 提早停止，就是自動偵測這件事的方式。演算法會說：「好，驗證準確率已持平，訓練準確率卻仍上升，

cues.en: We should probably just stop now so early stopping just means.
cues.zh: 大概該停了。」所以，提早停止只是表示，

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好，

cues.en: I know you wanted 10 epochs but I can see here that after five things are just getting worse as far as overfitting goes so we're gonna stop at five guys we're done here.
cues.zh: 我知道你想訓練十個週期，但看到五次之後，過度擬合變得更糟，所以各位，停在五次，完成了。

cues.en: That's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: That's all early stopping is about just making sure that you're not training your neural network further than you should and that prevents overfitting.
cues.zh: 提早停止，就是確保訓練不超過應有程度，防止過度擬合。

cues.en: Very simple solution there.
cues.zh: 很簡單的方法。
